# Dumbwork Customer Operations Templates
## 1. First Fix Scope Sheet
One proven system installed in 7 days after Activation Call, scope approval, and required info.
Includes tested workflow and handoff. Does not include custom software, paid ads, full CRM rebuilds, guaranteed bookings, guaranteed revenue, or unlimited changes.
## 2. Activation Call Agenda
Confirm workflow, confirm tools, confirm contact approvals, confirm required info.
## 3. Onboarding Checklist
Business hours, alert contact, approval contact, booking/callback link, message tone.
## 4. Message Approval Sheet
Approve recommendation, follow-up, reminder, and handoff messages before go-live.
## 5. QA Test Log
Run 3 fake leads/quotes/jobs and record pass/fail.
## 6. Handoff Guide
How to monitor, approve, and update the installed workflow.
## 7. Final Payment Request
Final $300 due when system is live and tested.
## 8. Care Plan Offer
Optional monitoring and improvement support.
## 9. Referral Request
If useful, ask for one referral or case study intro.
## 10. Not-Fit Message
Manual review or not-fit response with safe boundaries.
